"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's growers and farmers are aging.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Much of America's farmland will be passed to the next generation of farmers with families.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Proposals for tax reforms contained elsewhere in this document will ensure that family farms will not be lost.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Agricultural producers and the jobs they generate throughout the entire food chain must confront volatility in both the weather and the markets.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for farm programs that enable agricultural producers to manage the extraordinary risk they meet in the fields every year.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Farm programs should be as cost-effective as they are functional, offering risk management tools that improve producers' ability to operate when times are tough.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Farm programs must contribute to balancing the budget.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Direct Payment program should end.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Support for programs like crop insurance that help manage risk and are counter-cyclical in nature.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
